display_fil: Kaso: May mataas na cholesterol si Liza
narration_fil: May mataas na cholesterol si Liza. Kumakain siya ng bawang at nais itigil ang niresetang gamot.
narration_en: Liza has high cholesterol. She eats garlic and wants to stop her prescribed medicine.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Allium sativum. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay butil; ang paksang gamit ay pagkontrol ng cholesterol sa payo ng clinician. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Ibalik ang desisyon sa clinician; huwag magtakda ng dami ng bawang bilang gamot.
narration_en: Find Allium sativum on the reference card. The listed part is bulb; the use topic is cholesterol management under clinical advice. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Return the decision to the clinician; do not prescribe an amount of garlic as medicine.

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Bawang.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Bawang is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_en: The BHW points to Bawang and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Return the decision to the clinician; do not prescribe an amount of garlic as medicine.

narration_fil: Ang bawang sa pagkain ay hindi pahintulot na baguhin ang gamot. Itanong ang iba pang iniinom at posibleng epekto. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: Garlic as food does not authorize a medication change. Ask about other medicines and possible effects. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.
